The '''1947 National Division''' was the tenth edition of the [[Turkish National Division]]. [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] won their third title.

==Participants==

*[[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 1st
*[[Vefa S.K.|Vefa]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 2nd
*[[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 3rd
*[[Galatasaray S.K. (football)|Galatasaray]] - [[Istanbul Football League]], 4th
*[[Ankara Demirspor]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 1st
*[[Gençlerbirliği]] - [[Ankara Football League]], 2nd
*[[Altay S.K.|Altay]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 2nd
*[[Altınordu F.K.|Altınordu]] - [[İzmir Football League]], 3rd
